mentions.name: Forge
mentions.description: This tool completely automates JSON parsing and normalization in cloud data warehouses, unlocking the analytical possibilities of JSON data and eliminating the hours engineers typically spend wrestling with it manually.
mentions.problem: Engineers spend dozens of hours agonizing over how to unlock the analytical possibilities of JSON data in their warehouse, and existing solutions are half-finished and unreliable.
mentions.audience: Engineers and data teams working with JSON data in cloud data warehouses.
mentions.source_excerpt: Completely automating the difficult problem of json parsing and normalization in cloud data warehouses.  https://forge.foxtrotcommunications.net/
